query:
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT kept_recordings FROM guild_limits WHERE guild_id = $1), 0)
                      AS "cap!",
                  (SELECT count(DISTINCT recording_session_id)
                     FROM kept_recordings
                    WHERE guild_id = $1) AS "kept!",
                  (SELECT count(*)
                     FROM kept_recordings
                    WHERE guild_id = $1 AND user_id = $2) AS "used!",
                  COALESCE((SELECT retention_days FROM guild_limits WHERE guild_id = $1), $3)
                      AS "retention_days!"
